title: From design to a playable build
summary: A proposed production order, not a claim that gameplay is implemented. **Current focus: engine setup and the earliest possible packaged build.** Update each entry only with observed progress.

items.title: Visual development hub
items.body:
**Prepared:** project brief, original scene diagrams, character board, production board and skill guide.

No game runtime or finished art is implied. This board records planned work rather than starting it.

items.title: 01 / Unreal + MCP
items.body:
Install the selected Linux engine build and verify editor launch. Enable the built-in Unreal MCP toolsets and confirm a real read call from Codex.

**Known state:** download was started by the owner; extraction and connection have not been verified.

items.title: 02 / First Windows package
items.body:
Use the same Unreal version on the Windows packaging host. Produce and run a minimal standalone build early.

**Pass:** it starts on Windows without development tools. Avoid leaving this until delivery day.

items.title: 03 / Two-space blockout
items.body:
Create the marble gallery, central throne, eight painting interactions, raised ceremony table, open buffer and standing crowd area.

**Pass:** bounded movement and return transitions are usable. Exact viewpoints remain proposals.

items.title: 04 / One replayable ceremony
items.body:
Stage the shared event with grape action, attackers, sound cues, guard ring and collapse.

**Pass:** replaying from every position preserves event timing. Guards walk with the king, never carry him.

items.title: 05 / Mind world
items.body:
Pause the event and timer, show a top-down character selection, then 3–4 thought nodes for one character.

**Pass:** king excluded; other in-area characters eligible; close resumes correctly; one use resets per visit.

items.title: 06 / Statements & final answer
items.body:
Author observation/interpretation statements, answer unlock mappings and confirmation.

**Pass:** answering after one visit is possible; cancel works; incorrect commitment clears all progress; correct answer finishes.

items.title: 07 / Art, sound & blind playtest
items.body:
Produce approved art and animations, integrate audible attack cues, then watch a new player investigate without explanation.

**Pass:** the real cause is observable and inferable; no mandatory per-painting clue tour. Record source licenses.

items.title: 08 / Human submission
items.body:
Create the English game description, asset/tool credits and 30–60 second 1080p gameplay video. Test the final packaged build.

**Recorded deadline:** 16 November 2026 at 04:59 Europe/Istanbul. Verify on the jam page. The human participant performs the final submission.
